title: json-match grader with fixtures and PROTOCOL text
goal: Free text, free numbers and set-like arrays no longer fail a correct answer
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals 1 to 3 of the shared-asset review, solution:F-016-T09); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".
`json-match` expected kind: ignored paths, per-path numeric range or tolerance, order-free arrays; deterministic; `gauntlet validate` accepts and checks it
Fixtures: a pass and a fail per rule, including a reply in Italian with accented characters under an ignored path and a wrong value outside it; failing tests first
Documented in PROTOCOL; an example in the pack format guide
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: A grader kind with three rules, fixtures and docs. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
